what: Forecast error vs time on the 10 Dysts systems; periodic re-encoding at each run's validation-selected period (the paper's reported rollout); final checkpoint; 100 held-out test starts x 15 seeds per model; 5,000 stored steps = 5 dominant periods.
aggregation: squared error at step t = ||x_hat_t - x_t||^2 summed over state coordinates (float32, divergence fallback to the training-mean state as in the forecasting evaluation). Per run: median over the 100 test starts at each step. Line: median over the 15 seeds of these per-seed medians; band: 25th-75th percentile over seeds (numpy linear interpolation).
